title: SupplyChainSecurity
description: NIS2-sourced archetype — supply chain and supplier relationship security under Directive (EU) 2022/2555. Defines the vocabulary for assessing ICT supply chain risk and supplier security posture. Rootless — regulatory compliance dimension. Source: NIS2 Article 21(2)(d), Article 21(3).

supplierAssessmentCompleted.description: Whether the entity has assessed the security of direct suppliers and service providers. Source: NIS2 Art 21(2)(d).

supplierSecurityLevel.description: Assessment result of the supplier's overall security posture. NOT_ASSESSED: no assessment performed. INADEQUATE: assessment found deficiencies. ADEQUATE: assessment satisfactory. VERIFIED: independently audited.

secureDevProcedureVerified.description: Whether secure development procedures of suppliers have been verified. Source: NIS2 Art 21(3) (taking into account the results of coordinated security risk assessments of critical supply chains).

vulnerabilityManagementIncluded.description: Whether supplier contracts include vulnerability handling and disclosure requirements. Source: NIS2 Art 21(2)(d) (including vulnerability handling and disclosure).

supplyChainRiskLevel.description: Assessed risk level of the ICT supply chain relationship. Considers the overall quality and resilience of ICT products and services, and cybersecurity risk-management measures embedded in them. Source: NIS2 Art 21(2)(d).
